items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: What did you like? Did you have a preference for any particular – or maybe particular composers rather than styles?

I think – yeah, I liked the Beethoven sonatas. I liked Chopin. I liked Bach. During that period – of course my taste now is much broader and much wider, but as I recall the things that I was studying with Dorothy Mendelsohn – I liked Brahms.
